name: switch
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Switch for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned keyboard/ARIA switch primitive, composing SwitchThumb with a translate-x thumb animation driven by data-state.
documentation.usage: Switch { checked: checked(), on_checked_change: move |v| checked.set(v) }
documentation.accessibility: `role="switch"` with `aria-checked`, per the WAI-ARIA APG Switch pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/switch.rs`). A hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` mirrors state for plain HTML form submission.
documentation.keyboard: Toggles only on Space, not Enter -- matching the APG's guidance that a switch behaves like a checkbox for activation, not a button.
